origin.description: The minimum and maximum number of context lines the auto setting may choose.

arguments.name: min
arguments.text: An integer of at least 0. Zero allows any small context.

arguments.name: max
arguments.text: An integer. A negative value allows any large context.

origin.details: The help examples pass this object to diffChr. The recorded call prints the object itself: min and max.

translation.description: An AutoContext with the same min and max.

arguments.name: min
arguments.text: An int of at least 0. Omitted values read diffobj.context.auto.min.

arguments.name: max
arguments.text: An int. A negative value is kept. Omitted values read diffobj.context.auto.max.

translation.details: 0 is allowed. A negative min raises the same message as a non-integer, which says the value must be greater than zero.
translation.example:
from diffobj import auto_context
item = auto_context(0, 3)
print(item.min, item.max)
